0022600112.text: The Lakers, 1-0 and second in the Pacific, visit the Utah Jazz, who are 1-1 and fourth in the Northwest, one game back, and eighth in the West. The Lakers beat Utah 4-0 in the 2025-26 season series, and their most recent meeting was a 131-107 Lakers win in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026, while the 2026-27 season series has no games yet. Lakers Adou Thiero (knee, inflammation), Cameron Carr (oblique, strain), and Jake LaRavia (ankle, sprain) are out, and Utah's Jusuf Nurkic (foot, strain) and Trey Alexander (knee, bruise) are also out.
